info.title: An Cu VNeID property import
info.description: Implemented Auth0 simulation source. Source-owned assets only; manual property review remains separate. Source evidence stays separate from Admin decisions; properties/units stay shared. Source rightDescription is retained for new imports. Receiving account is owner-declared, name-matched to linked verified citizen; not bank verification. Current28October: ACTIVE VERIFIED CUSTOMER or OWNER with explicit current linked-source consent may preview/import. Preview/consent does not promote. Successful complete source import atomically grants OWNER if needed; source property is not a manual onboarding dossier.

get.summary: After explicit source consent, read exact linked verified account assets without granting Owner

200.description: Private/no-store candidates: asset + sourceVersion + imported; own imports additionally expose propertyId (decimal string), propertyVersion, unitStates [{externalUnitId,apartmentId,publicationStatus}] and nullable appendBlockedReason. Unmapped legacy properties return SOURCE_UNIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Foreign imports expose no local property ID or unit states. Existing hidden rooms remain imported. No issuer/subject/token/credentials.

403.description: VNEID_REQUIRED, ASSET_CONSENT_REQUIRED or ineligible account; no provider call before consent

post.summary: Complete rental terms and import/publish a source-owned asset without Admin review
post.description: Create one property and only the selected nonempty subset of source rooms. Validate fresh sourceVersion, exact identity/consent, unique valid source unit IDs and complete terms for selected rooms only. In one transaction persist approved source-owned property, selected published apartments, immutable source batch/mappings and eligible owner activation. Unselected rooms have no local apartment or invented price/readings. Old clients selecting all rooms remain supported.

201.description: OwnerPropertyCreated {property,apartments}; no-store. Property includes verificationSource AUTH0_VNEID_SIMULATION. Apartment/public detail include nullable electricityUnitPrice/waterUnitPrice decimal strings.

409.description: ASSET_ALREADY_IMPORTED, ASSET_SOURCE_CHANGED, VNEID_LINK_CHANGED or concurrent RESOURCE_CONFLICT

put.summary: Exact active Owner updates private receiving account for imported source property

204.description: Saved with optimistic version; no-store. Existing draft snapshots unchanged.

post.summary: Append selected source rooms to an own existing source property
post.description: Internal session, ACTIVE persisted VNeID and current exact source consent required. Fresh provider read occurs outside SQL locks. Inside the account/property lock recheck binding, property version/approval/ownership, unchanged legal evidence, complete legacy mappings and source-unit uniqueness. Creates/publishes selected new rooms and one immutable audit batch atomically. Preserves parent metadata/images/receiving configuration, existing rooms, requests, signed/unsigned saved contracts and financial history. Duplicate/racing selections fail without partial creation. New manual-unit endpoints remain forbidden for source imports.

201.description: OwnerPropertyCreated: existing property plus all its current apartments; no-store

400.description: Empty/duplicate/unknown selected IDs, incomplete or invalid terms, forged authority/parent fields

404.description: Foreign/local non-source property or current source asset unavailable

409.description: STALE_VERSION, ASSET_SOURCE_CHANGED, VNEID_LINK_CHANGED, SOURCE_UNIT_ALREADY_IMPORTED, SOURCE_ROOM_CODE_CONFLICT, SOURCE_UNIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, ASSET_LEGAL_SOURCE_CHANGED or SOURCE_PROPERTY_NOT_ELIGIBLE

imageIds.description: Own unused staged property-image IDs. Order determines cover. Bound atomically.

monthlyRent.description: Decimal >0, up to 13 integer/2 fraction digits

deposit.description: Decimal >=0, up to 13 integer/2 fraction digits
